board_posts_replay.name: board_posts_replay
board_posts_replay.value: deletion_reason IS 'withdrawn' OR (request_id IS NOT NULL AND body_hash IS NOT NULL)

board_posts_attachment.name: board_posts_attachment
board_posts_attachment.value: (match_id IS NULL AND position IS NULL) OR (match_id IS NOT NULL AND position IS NOT NULL AND position >= 0)

match_participant_accounts_check_2.name: match_participant_accounts_check_2
match_participant_accounts_check_2.value: (state IN ('retired','rejected') AND account_id IS NULL) OR (state IN ('pending','applied') AND account_id IS NOT NULL)

tournaments_check_4.name: tournaments_check_4
tournaments_check_4.value: rule_version=1 OR (settings_json IS NOT NULL AND json_valid(settings_json) AND json_extract(settings_json,'$.game') IS game)

tournaments_check_5.name: tournaments_check_5
tournaments_check_5.value: published = 0 OR (public_id > 0 AND starts_at_ms IS NOT NULL AND ends_at_ms > starts_at_ms)
